_about: CLOSE6 (alpha item 6, G2 + G6): one-time onboarding prompt of a fresh save, read by Scripts/HUD/DirectionPrompt.cs. enabled false or no file = nothing. Shows showDelayS after boot, one line every secondsPerLine (fade fadeS), paused while the pause menu is open; a dismissKeys key (KeyCode names) skips the rest. After the last line or a skip, PlayerPrefs <prefsKey> = 1 and it never shows again; Pause > New game clears the flag. Change prefsKey (v2 ...) to show it again to everyone. kbm = keyboard / mouse lines, pad = lines when a gamepad is connected. Words in braces are filled from the live bindings: {strike} {guard} {thrust} {guardLeft} {guardRight} {guardUp} (any controls.json bindings action id, current keys after rebinding), {padStrike} {padGuard} (controls.json pad.attackKeys / pad.guardKeys, named by menu.json padNames). The directions follow controls.json attack.sectors / guard.sides: no slide = thrust, slide up = overhead, left / right = slash; guard side by slide or right stick, down = low. x / y = panel centre as a screen fraction (y from the top); width, padPx and font sizes are reference-1080 px (hud.json scale). font / titleFont = hud.json fonts kind (serif, title, ui). Colours RGBA 0..1. skipArgs = command-line prefixes that keep it off (harness runs are off anyway).
title: HOW TO FIGHT
kbm: The slide of your mouse picks the blow. Press {strike} to strike: tap for a light blow, hold for a heavy one.
THRUST: press {strike} with the mouse still (or press {thrust}).
OVERHEAD: slide the mouse up as you press {strike}.
SLASH LEFT: slide the mouse left as you press {strike}.
SLASH RIGHT: slide the mouse right as you press {strike}.
GUARD: hold {guard}. A guard only stops a blow on the side it covers.
GUARD LEFT / RIGHT / HIGH: hold {guard} and slide the mouse left, right or up (or press {guardLeft}, {guardRight}, {guardUp}). Slide down for a low guard.
Read the blow, then guard its side: a cut needs the guard on the side it lands, an overhead needs the high guard.
pad: The right stick picks the blow. Press {padStrike} to strike: tap for a light blow, hold for a heavy one.
THRUST: press {padStrike} with the right stick at rest.
OVERHEAD: flick the right stick up as you press {padStrike}.
SLASH LEFT: flick the right stick left as you press {padStrike}.
SLASH RIGHT: flick the right stick right as you press {padStrike}.
GUARD: hold {padGuard}. A guard only stops a blow on the side it covers.
GUARD LEFT / RIGHT / HIGH: hold {padGuard} and push the right stick left, right or up. Push it down for a low guard.
Read the blow, then guard its side: a cut needs the guard on the side it lands, an overhead needs the high guard.
